episodeTitle.en: From skeptic to true believer: How OpenClaw changed my life | Claire Vo
episodeTitle.zh: 从怀疑者到忠实信徒：OpenClaw如何改变我的生活 | 克莱尔·沃

guestBioOfficial.en: Claire Vo is the host of our sister podcast, “How I AI,” a former product executive and engineer, and founder of an AI startup called ChatPRD. Claire now runs her business, podcast, and family life with the help of nine OpenClaw agents running on multiple Mac Minis and old laptops. In this episode, Claire shares her journey from OpenClaw skeptic (it deleted her family calendar the first time she tried it) to true believer, and gives a masterclass in using AI agents in real life. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 克莱尔·沃是我们姊妹播客《How I AI》的主持人，曾任产品高管和工程师，也是AI初创公司ChatPRD的创始人。如今，她借助九台OpenClaw智能助手，在多台Mac Mini和旧笔记本电脑上运营业务、主持播客并打理家庭生活。在本期节目中，克莱尔分享了自己从OpenClaw怀疑者（首次尝试时删掉了家庭日历）到忠实信徒的转变历程，并传授如何在现实生活中运用AI助手的秘籍。*我们将探讨：*

title.en: From skeptic to true believer: How OpenClaw changed my life | Claire Vo
title.zh: 从怀疑者到忠实信徒：OpenClaw如何改变我的生活 | 克莱尔·沃

summary.en: Claire discusses which PM skills AI will complement or replace, the story behind ChatPRD, and how to stay ahead of the curve on AI within the PM role. She emphasizes retaining agency over your career and “bending the arc” toward what you want, plus insights on being a successful woman in tech and the rise of the combined CPTO role. The conversation is rich with career advice for both early and senior product people.
summary.zh: Claire 讨论了哪些 PM 技能会被 AI 补充或替代、ChatPRD 背后的故事，以及如何在 PM 角色中保持对 AI 的领先。她强调要对职业生涯保留“主动权”并“扭转弧线”朝向自己想要的方向，以及身为科技行业成功女性、CPTO 角色崛起的洞见。对话富含对早期与资深产品人的职业建议。
